slides.title:
You sold your fund.
So where's the **money?**
Selling is only **half** the job.
slides.body: Every trade has two steps. First the deal. Then **settlement**: the moment cash and units actually swap hands.

slides.title: That second step takes a **business day**, at least.
slides.body: US and Indian stock and ETF trades settle the next business day. Fund redemptions often take 1 to 3. Weekends don't count.
slides.source: Sources: SEC T+1 rule (May 2024) · SEBI T+1 (Jan 2023)

slides.title: On-chain, the deal **is** the settlement.
slides.body: Trade and transfer happen together, on a public ledger, any day of the week. The catch: prices swing more and the tech is newer. Start small.

slides.title: Your money shouldn't wait for **Monday.**
slides.body: Follow BLOK Capital for plain-English on-chain portfolio know-how. One idea a week.
slides.disclaimer: Educational content only, not financial or investment advice. On-chain assets can be volatile and you can lose money.
